notes: Hand-assembled, not generated by `tubuild.py create`: tu_map cannot segment arm9/main, so there was no candidate id to create from. The schema follows the arm9/dCcAc_c and arm9/Clipper entries, which took the same route.

MaterialChanger is the Animation child that plays a BMA_File against ModelComponents: Update forwards the fixed-point cursor; SetFile swaps the file and re-arms the base animation through dExtFrameCtrl_c::SetAnimation; Prepare is a static long-call veneer over func_020470e8.

The whole class folds, lifecycle variants included: the cartridge's D0,D1,C1 order is the order one ~MaterialChanger() plus one MaterialChanger() emits under deferred codegen (the emitted D2 and C2 siblings have no cartridge home and deadstrip unenrolled), so no per-variant shards remain.

SetFile stays a mangled extern "C" definition (wall 6az, notes/mwccarm-codegen.md): the Fix12<int> by-value parameter keeps the free spelling, and its call to dExtFrameCtrl_c::SetAnimation keeps the mangled spelling too because passing the real declaration's Fix12<int> by value homes the argument to the caller's stack. SetFlags, by contrast, takes a plain int and is spelled as the member call it is.
The file is written ROM-descending because mwccarm emits .text in reverse source order under default deferred codegen; the emitted object carries the six functions ascending 0x0201577c..0x0201587c.

The cartridge spells this class dExtAnmMaterial_c and its base dExtFrameCtrl_c (include/dExtFrameCtrl_c.h, notes/model-rtti-names.md), so _ZTS/_ZTI records emitted under the project's MaterialChanger/Animation spellings would have no configured ROM home. This TU therefore compiles with #pragma RTTI off, the same lever the merged ShadowModel fold uses for the identical dExt* coined-name situation: no RTTI records are emitted, and the vtable preamble's typeinfo word deadstrips with the rest of the .data output.
